source: KCET 2024 Round 1 engineering cutoffs (General Merit, Karnataka state quota)
notes: Cutoffs are from KEA's published Round 1 allotment data for KCET 2024, General Merit category. Real cutoffs vary by category (2A, 3A, 3B, SC, ST), region, and round. Treat these as indicative, not guaranteed.

bands.name: Elite CSE at top colleges
bands.description: Computer Science / AI / DS at RVCE, BMS, MSRIT, PES — the most competitive seats in Karnataka. Requires a near-top General Merit rank.

bands.name: Top core branches or tier-2 CSE
bands.description: ECE / Mech / Civil at the top private colleges above, plus CSE at BIT, Dayananda Sagar, and similar tier-2 colleges in Bengaluru.

bands.name: Competitive engineering seats
bands.description: Core branches at tier-2 private colleges in Bengaluru, Mangalore, Mysuru. Many full private-college programs open up here.

bands.name: General engineering access
bands.description: Most engineering seats at private colleges across Karnataka become accessible. Includes niche programs, affiliated colleges, and non-metro colleges.

bands.name: Narrow chances via General Merit alone
bands.description: Consider category quota (if applicable), management or NRI quota, COMEDK, other state CETs, or a retake with more focused prep. Reservation categories (SC/ST/2A/3A/3B) have more relaxed cutoffs.
